test_gcc_autotuning_smoke: run a smoke test for GCC autotuning with random, hillclimb, or genetic search strategies
check_docker_availability: check whether Docker is available on the system by calling docker.from_env
check_system_gcc_availability: check whether a system GCC compiler is available and return a cached boolean result
get_system_gcc_path: get the absolute path of the system GCC compiler using the which command
list_available_gcc_bins: list all available GCC binaries including Docker containers and system GCC paths
